gwt.given: A connection has CircuitBreakerFailureCount 20 and CircuitBreakerTestInterval 5000 ms, and its resilience policy has just recorded its 20th consecutive execution failure.
gwt.when: A caller invokes a 21st execution on that connection within the next 5000 ms.
gwt.then: The execution fails immediately as a circuit-open failure and no command is attempted against the database for the remainder of that 5000 ms test interval.
